description: This file provides minimal schema validation helpers inspired by Joi/Zod, including functions for validating strings, numbers, booleans, and objects. It defines validation logic and error handling for data validation purposes.

methods.name: makeError(message, details)
methods.description: Creates an error object with a message and optional details.

methods.name: isPlainObject(v)
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain JavaScript object (not null, not an array).

methods.name: string({ min, max, optional = false, allowEmpty = false } = {})
methods.description: Creates a string validator with optional constraints like min, max length, and whether to allow empty or optional values.

methods.name: number({ min, max, integer = false, optional = false } = {})
methods.description: Creates a number validator with optional constraints like min, max, and integer requirement.

methods.name: boolean({ optional = false } = {})
methods.description: Creates a boolean validator with optional handling for string representations.

methods.name: object(shape, { allowUnknown = false } = {})
methods.description: Creates an object validator with a specified shape/schema and optional allowance of unknown fields.

ctags.name: number
ctags.pattern: /^function number({ min, max, integer = false, optional = false } = {}) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ min, max, integer = false, optional = false } = {})

ctags.name: string
ctags.pattern: /^function string({ min, max, optional = false, allowEmpty = false } = {}) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ min, max, optional = false, allowEmpty = false } = {})
